subject: planner: non-deterministic expression can not be pushed down throught the join (#65563)
summary: Reviewed this commit vs parent: it adds a guard in `LogicalJoin.ExtractOnCondition` to keep columnless mutable/side-effect predicates (e.g. `rand()>0.5`, `sysdate()...`) in `otherCond` instead of treating them as “const” and pushing them into join children; casetest expectations are updated accordingly, plus a minor goleak ignore in sessionctx variable tests. No remaining Blocker/High correctness/semantics issues found in the touched planner/sessionctx behavior.
